tagline: Social media management for you and your AI agents.

video.label: From one recruit to one thunder
video.description: A 41-second film with burned-in captions: install Blowhorn on as many computers as you like, they fall in as one unit, from a fireteam up, one order goes to one computer, your team joins as a squad, and Major Blowhorn's one call lands on LinkedIn, X, Bluesky, Reddit, GitHub, Hacker News and Slack.

variants.headline: Automate your social voice. Plug in AI anytime.
variants.subhead: Blowhorn posts exactly what you approve to LinkedIn, X, Reddit, Hacker News and more, from your own browser. Bring any AI agent, model or assistant.
variants.note: AI hybrid messaging (Yi, 2026-10-20). What Blowhorn is in four words, then the hybrid: scripted posting, AI whenever you want it.

variants.headline: Scripted where it counts. AI where it helps.
variants.subhead: Every post, reply and amplify runs exactly as written. Drafts, agents and assistants plug in through MCP, a REST API and a scriptable CLI.
variants.note: AI hybrid messaging, default and fallback (Yi, 2026-10-20 8:01 PM). The hybrid as a rule: deterministic actions, AI by choice, and the agent surfaces named.

variants.headline: You post. Your agent posts. Same rules.
variants.subhead: Drive LinkedIn, X, Reddit, Hacker News and more from the app, the CLI, MCP or your AI assistant. One queue, one set of limits.
variants.note: AI hybrid messaging. For the agent-heavy Alex persona: one queue and one set of limits, person or agent.

variants.headline: Your voice, automated. AI optional, never in charge.
variants.subhead: Blowhorn runs your schedule like clockwork, signed in as you. Write every word yourself, bring your own model, or let Blowhorn draft it.
variants.note: AI hybrid messaging. AI assists, the person decides; points at the content generation teaser.

variants.headline: One queue. Every profile. Human or AI.
variants.subhead: Publish and amplify from every profile you run, on every computer you own. Drive it by hand, by script or by AI agent.
variants.note: AI hybrid messaging. The fleet plus agents: any number of computers and profiles, three ways to drive.

variants.headline: Not a bot. You, at full volume.
variants.subhead: Blowhorn does the typing and clicking in your own browser, signed in as you, on computers you own. No Blowhorn server ever logs in as you.
variants.note: Default and fallback. Leads with the claim every competitor group lacks: a real browser, really you.

variants.headline: The real you, everywhere at once.
variants.subhead: Not a cloud bot borrowing your password. Your own browser, on your own computers, doing exactly what you queued.
variants.note: Same claim, framed against the LinkedIn tools that ask for your password.

variants.headline: Your fleet. Your browser. Your voice.
variants.subhead: Install Blowhorn on every computer you own. They share one queue, act as you, and are coordinated so the same post isn't sent from two of them.
variants.note: The fleet of your own computers behind one coordinated queue.

variants.headline: Real voices make a sound wave.
variants.subhead: Schedule one message and have every profile you add amplify it at the moment you pick, each profile posting as itself.
variants.note: The sound wave, with real people instead of bots.

variants.headline: Own your voice. Keep your accounts.
variants.subhead: The social console that runs in your own browser: LinkedIn, X, Reddit, Hacker News, Bluesky, GitHub and Slack from one queue, posted as you. About a minute to set up.
variants.note: After bindplane.com: a category claim with concrete proof (the networks, the setup time) and an ownership close like its "Own your telemetry. Control your costs."

variants.headline: You did not start a company to copy-paste for a living.
variants.subhead: Blowhorn is a social media console. Write one post, and it posts, reposts, and amplifies it across your LinkedIn, X, Reddit, Hacker News, Bluesky, GitHub, and Slack profiles, from your own browser, as you.
variants.identification: If this is you: you are the founder, the DevRel team, and the social team, and launch day is currently seven tabs and a prayer.
variants.note: Issue #254, tab chaos. Not in the production rotation; reachable via ?hero=copy-paste and the Easter egg hotkey.

variants.headline: Seven tabs. One post. Zero patience left.
variants.subhead: One queue for every profile you run. Blowhorn does the typing and clicking in your own browser, on a schedule you set.
variants.identification: If this is you: you have posted it once, and you know you still have to post it six more times.
variants.note: Issue #254, tab chaos. Not in the production rotation; reachable via ?hero=seven-tabs and the Easter egg hotkey.

variants.headline: Congratulations, you posted. Now do it everywhere else.
variants.subhead: Blowhorn takes one message and sends it, reposts it, and amplifies it across the profiles and platforms your community actually uses.
variants.identification: If this is you: your content calendar is a spreadsheet, your posting tool is you, and your afternoon is gone.
variants.note: Issue #254, tab chaos. Not in the production rotation; reachable via ?hero=congratulations-posted and the Easter egg hotkey.

variants.headline: Other tools want your password. And your cookie. And your 2FA secret.
variants.subhead: Blowhorn is a social media console that acts as you, in your browser. Your LinkedIn, X, Reddit and Hacker News sessions stay on your computer. Your account keeps the queue in sync. Your computers do the posting.
variants.identification: If this is you: you have stared at a vendor login screen and thought, absolutely not, that account is the company.
variants.note: Issue #254, custody. Not in the production rotation; reachable via ?hero=password-cookie-2fa and the Easter egg hotkey.

variants.headline: We are you, not a bot. And definitely not a vendor in a trench coat.
variants.subhead: No server logs in as you. Blowhorn posts from your profiles, in your browser, at a human pace, with a dry run first so you see exactly what will go out.
variants.identification: If this is you: you care less about automation magic and more about who is holding your accounts.
variants.note: Issue #254, custody. Not in the production rotation; reachable via ?hero=not-a-vendor and the Easter egg hotkey.

variants.headline: Your accounts are not a rental property.
variants.subhead: Blowhorn is a social media console for your computers. One queue, many profiles, and the sessions that matter stay on your computer, not on a vendor server.
variants.identification: If this is you: you run client or company accounts and you have had to answer, "where do my logins live?"
variants.note: Issue #254, custody. Not in the production rotation; reachable via ?hero=not-rental and the Easter egg hotkey.

variants.headline: Your launch post deserves better than nine likes and a Slack pity-react.
variants.subhead: Post once, and Blowhorn amplifies it from every profile you run, in the first hour, when early replies tend to matter most, so it does not sit flat while you are still pasting it elsewhere.
variants.identification: If this is you: you have shipped something real and then begged in Slack with "can everyone like this?"
variants.note: Issue #254, flat launch. Not in the production rotation; reachable via ?hero=nine-likes and the Easter egg hotkey.

variants.headline: One message. Many ears. No group-chat begging.
variants.subhead: Blowhorn is a social media console. One message goes in, and it is broadcast, reposted, and amplified across your profiles and platforms.
variants.identification: If this is you: you are tired of launch momentum depending on who happens to be online to repost you.
variants.note: Issue #254, flat launch. Not in the production rotation; reachable via ?hero=no-begging and the Easter egg hotkey.

variants.headline: You shipped it. Now say it like you mean it.
variants.subhead: Write it once in Blowhorn, and your project, company, and personal profiles all say it, in their own places, on schedule.
variants.identification: If this is you: you are an open source maintainer or DevRel lead speaking through three voices at once, and Hacker News, GitHub, and Slack are not optional extras.
variants.note: Issue #254, flat launch. Not in the production rotation; reachable via ?hero=say-it-like-you-mean-it and the Easter egg hotkey.

variants.headline: Enterprise advocacy tools want 100 seats. You have four people and a launch.
variants.subhead: Blowhorn is a social media console for small technical teams. One shared queue, as many computers as you own, and amplification from every profile you run. Team onboarding is Coming soon.
variants.identification: If this is you: you got a quote with a seat minimum and laughed, then cried a little.
variants.note: Issue #254, startup priced out. Not in the production rotation; reachable via ?hero=hundred-seats and the Easter egg hotkey.

variants.headline: A $298 stack, and you still do Hacker News by hand.
variants.subhead: Blowhorn replaces the scheduler plus the LinkedIn tool plus the manual tab-juggling, with one queue for LinkedIn, X, Reddit, Hacker News, Bluesky, GitHub, and Slack.
variants.identification: If this is you: you are paying for three tools and still doing the hardest platform yourself.
variants.note: Issue #254, startup priced out. Not in the production rotation; reachable via ?hero=298-stack and the Easter egg hotkey.

variants.headline: Built by a small team, for teams too small for the enterprise demo.
variants.subhead: Blowhorn is a startup social media console for your computers. We know what launch week feels like, because we live it too. One message in, many ears out, no seat math.
variants.identification: If this is you: you are a 1 to 50 person technical company, and "talk to sales" is not a pricing plan.
variants.note: Issue #254, startup priced out. Not in the production rotation; reachable via ?hero=too-small-for-demo and the Easter egg hotkey.
